stories.title: Ohio State replaces BYU at No. 2 as Top 25 jumbled again by top-10 losses
stories.summary: No. 1 Miami was the only team to hold its spot in The Associated Press Top 25 on Sunday as idle Ohio State moved up to No. 2 and the poll went through another major reordering in the wake of BYU's loss at UCF and subsequent six-spot fall to No. 8.

stories.title: Rodgers now alone with 3rd-most TD passes as Steelers win 1st Paris game
stories.summary: Aaron Rodgers threw one touchdown pass to move alone to third on the career list during the Steelers' 16-10 win over the Saints as the NFL held its first regular-season game in France.

stories.title: Sixers overrule Embiid, sit center with plantar fasciitis management
stories.summary: Despite publicly calling to play Sunday against the Pistons, the 76ers decided to sit Joel Embiid due to right foot plantar fasciitis management.

stories.title: Missouri RB Hardy to practice for first time since getting shot
stories.summary: Missouri consensus All-America RB Ahmad Hardy, who was shot at a concert in May and has yet to play this season, will return to practice this week.

stories.title: Panthers RT Moton suffers fractured fibula, will be 'out for a while'
stories.summary: Panthers right tackle Taylor Moton left Sunday's matchup against the Buccaneers on a cart in the third quarter with a left ankle and fibula injury.
